title: SmallSide activity
description: Published activity versions are immutable, except for moment and all_phase: those are classification metadata about the drill, not drill content — they don't change what a coach or player does — so they may be added or corrected on an existing version in place rather than forcing a new version. Do not extend this exemption to any other field without a deliberate decision, since it exists specifically to let a mislabeled moment/all_phase be fixed without version churn.

moment.description: The drill's primary coaching focus. Single-valued even for a drill that touches more than one moment — see all_phase for a drill that genuinely exercises all three. Required unless all_phase is true. "none" is for a drill with no ball/possession concept at all (a tag or movement game) — like all_phase, it is excluded from a session's moment-coverage denominator rather than forced into the possession taxonomy.

all_phase.description: Optional. Set true only for a drill that genuinely exercises all three moments of the game (free scrimmage, multi-goal games). When true, moment must be omitted — the validator rejects an activity that sets both, since a single primary moment doesn't apply. Its minutes are excluded from the denominator of a session's minutes-weighted moment coverage, and shown separately as uncounted time rather than folded into a moment silently.
